equipped_weapon.name: Shadow Blade
equipped_weapon.description: A dark blade that seems to absorb light.

entrance.name: Dungeon Entrance
entrance.description: You stand at the entrance of a dark, foreboding dungeon. Cold air seeps from the depths below. Torches flicker on the walls.

corridor_1.name: Narrow Corridor
corridor_1.description: A narrow stone corridor stretches ahead. The walls are damp and covered in moss. You hear scratching sounds nearby.

enemies.name: Rat
enemies.description: A mangy sewer rat with glowing red eyes.

armory.name: Abandoned Armory
armory.description: Rusted weapons line the walls of this old armory. Most are useless, but something catches your eye...

hall.name: Great Hall
hall.description: A vast hall with crumbling pillars. Bones litter the floor. Multiple passages lead deeper into the dungeon.

enemies.name: Goblin
enemies.description: A sneaky goblin wielding a rusty dagger.

library.name: Ancient Library
library.description: Dusty bookshelves tower to the ceiling. Most books have crumbled to dust, but a faint magical glow emanates from one corner.

treasury.name: Hidden Treasury
treasury.description: Gold coins and precious gems are scattered across a stone table. It seems too good to be true...

enemies.name: Skeleton
enemies.description: An animated skeleton clad in ancient armor.

corridor_2.name: Dark Passageway
corridor_2.description: The air grows colder as you descend deeper. Shadows seem to move on their own. A faint chanting echoes from ahead.

enemies.name: Dark Mage
enemies.description: A hooded mage crackling with dark energy.

altar.name: Sacrificial Altar
altar.description: A blood-stained altar sits at the center of this circular room. Dark runes glow on the floor.

enemies.name: Wraith
enemies.description: A ghostly wraith drifting through the darkness.

crypt.name: Underground Crypt
crypt.description: Ancient tombs line the walls. The path narrows ahead as you approach the heart of the dungeon.

enemies.name: Troll
enemies.description: A massive troll blocking the passage.

boss_room.name: Dragon's Lair
boss_room.description: A massive cavern opens before you. The heat is overwhelming. In the center, a Shadow Dragon raises its head and fixes its burning eyes upon you. This is the final challenge.

enemies.name: Shadow Dragon
enemies.description: A fearsome dragon wreathed in living shadows. The final guardian.

exit_room.name: Dungeon Exit
exit_room.description: Sunlight floods through a gap in the rocks. You can see the sky! You have conquered the Realm of Shadows!
